correctness.rationale: For every positive two-stage irreducible Metzler flow, a fixed diagonal similarity symmetrizes its generator; the pulse flow becomes symmetric positive definite and its conjugated diagonal impulse factors are symmetric. Cyclic rotations and transpose-reversal generate all at most three permutations and preserve spectra. A concrete valid two-stage parameter choice produces E=(1/sqrt2)E0, with E0 rational, so all four-pulse monodromy entries rational. The two chronological orders give exact det(I-P)=4829579/512000000>0 and -16871941/512000000<0 with common positive determinant 50787/16000000<1. Positive 2x2 Perron theory gives opposite extinction/growth. Actual final verifier reproduces arithmetic; finite permutation enumeration is not the general proof.

originality.rationale: Motivating arXiv:2609.10581v1 defines fixed-D periodic impulses and the positive full-resistance ecological subsystem. The arXiv:2310.07616 analysis takes D fixed while varying the pulse interval; the Mermer 2020/2021 treatment-order comparison concerns a finite season with external weather and four life stages. No inspected source establishes the all-permutation at most three asymptotic invariance plus a biologically admissible k=4 extinction-versus-growth exact witness. Cyclic similarity and transpose are standard and expressly not claimed as new. Originality has residual risk from unindexed results and the uninspected full text of a two-application empirical 2023 study.
residual_risks: A less-visible mathematical biology or matrix-product paper may state the same four-pulse threshold under a different vocabulary.
The 2023 two-treatment insecticide application article was not inspected in full; its abstract describes a distinct design, but full-document exclusion is not established.
The order-invariance mechanism itself is an elementary existing matrix principle, not novel in isolation.

value.rationale: Pulse order is a well-motivated pest-control and resistant-population question, as emphasized by the motivating model and Mermer et al. The finding identifies the first possible number of distinct pulse occurrences whose rearrangement can alter a two-stage population long-term fate, not merely a transient level, with no change to any dose or timing interval. The exact sharp witness crossing the unit Floquet threshold is substantively stronger than reproducing a known epidemic or ecological threshold formula; application scope and unproved extensions are explicitly delimited.
